title: unified rollouts: canary, A/B, shadow traffic, and automated rollback workflow
author: Diego Morales
description:
Motivation: Provide a single, first-class rollout system for model lifecycle management across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. This implements canary deploys, A/B experiments, shadow traffic, and an automated rollback controller driven by SLO/metric thresholds. The goal is to replace ad-hoc rollout scripts with a consistent, observable, and policy-driven flow that integrates with Redwood Console and the Optimize recommendations.

What this PR does: Adds a unified rollout controller and APIs + console wiring. Key features: canary strategy (percent-based gradual ramp, stage duration, health metric checks), A/B experiments (traffic split with tie-breaker policies and metric collection), shadow traffic mode (send copy of live traffic to a candidate model for offline eval), automated rollback policy (monitor configured metrics and rollback on sustained degradation), rollout policy CRD/API surface for both hosted and private control-planes, rollout events and tracing for easy debugging, rollout CLI and Console UX wiring, integration tests and migration notes.

Implementation notes: Controller implemented in rollout-service package (runtime-safe, idempotent reconciliation loop). New API surface: POST /rollouts (create), GET /rollouts/:id, PATCH /rollouts/:id/scale, POST /rollouts/:id/abort. Rollout spec supports strategies: {type: canary|ab|shadow}, canary fields: initial_percent, step_percent, step_duration_seconds, success_metric{name, threshold, window_seconds}, max_duration_seconds. A/B supports variants with model refs and percentage weights; weight adjustment APIs enable ramping variants. Shadow supports sampling_rate and async sink for model outputs. Rollout controller hooks into metrics pipeline and triggers a graceful rollback by re-pointing traffic to previous model version and marking the rollout as failed. Automated rollback uses a configurable evaluation window and requires consecutive evaluation failures to avoid flapping.

Backward compatibility: Existing route configs without rollout_spec continue to work. Rollout data stored in new rollout-index; migration step included to ensure older records remain untouched. Feature flag rollout.unified_rollouts=false disables controller and API surface.

Testing: unit tests for controller reconciliation, integration tests simulating canary ramp (with fake metrics provider), E2E test in perf-canary that runs a short-lived canary against a tiny GPT-like model, and console e2e flows for creating and aborting rollouts. CI: initial integration flake fixed by increasing fake metric resolution.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller implementation and unit tests
- [x] API endpoints and auth checks
- [x] Console wiring and UX screenshots
- [x] Integration and e2e tests
- [x] Migration guide and docs
- [x] Release notes entry

Related linear tasks: ENG-987, ENG-1010, PM-412. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-987/unified-rollouts-design (internal).
